about.text: A yellowish white cheese similar to Pecorino Romano, although the latter is made from sheep's milk while Sardo is made with cow's milk. In its youth, Sardo is a semi-hard cheese with a soft, sweet and aromatic flavor, and as it matures it acquires more hardness and a more intense flavor. In fact, Sardo may also be considered a hard cheese.

sources.text: Argentine, Pecorino Romano-inspired, cow milk, hard granular grating cheese; at least 90 days (max assumed)
